verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is a law firm offering legal services plus founder resources such as a glossary, FAQs and document generators. An interactive API reference with runnable examples is not a fair axis for this kind of product. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships a developer API, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
